meta.description: TR-22, Blueprint §10 flow 5. 1st 06:00: seal the prior calendar month -> render dept+company PDFs via the report-renderer sidecar -> notify the configured reports stakeholders with links. Identical shape to reports-weekly-seal.json (same file's header explains: calendar-only by construction, narrative fail-soft already lives inside TR-15's sealPeriod/document-builder.ts so this flow never calls anything AI-shaped itself, idempotent-via-recheck rather than parsing the seal call's error body, per-scope export isolation, static REPORTS_NOTIFY_USER_IDS recipient list, link-not-numbers notify body) -- see that file's `meta.description` for the full reasoning, not repeated here. The ONE thing this ticket's brief adds beyond the weekly flow -- 'when an appraisal cycle covers that month: pre-generate auto_inputs refresh notice to HR' -- is DELIBERATELY NOT WIRED in this file. TR-24 (the appraisal engine + endpoints) is a DIFFERENT, actively-in-progress ticket in this exact module right now, and as of this ticket's implementation there is no landed read surface anywhere (no appraisals.controller.ts, no 'does a cycle cover this date' endpoint) for this flow to call -- report_appraisal_cycles exists as a bare schema table (TR-23/migration 0068) with no application-code reader yet. Inventing that endpoint's contract unilaterally, while the ticket that owns it is mid-flight, risks exactly the kind of contract collision this program's own §15 amendment log repeatedly flags as costly to unwind. This is a genuine, disclosed dependency gap -- not a shortcut -- kept inert the same way this repo's own `on-inbound-lead`/`digest-fanout` flows are documented as deferred pending a dependency that does not exist yet (see automation/README.md's 'Deferred flows' section and its new TR-22 follow-up note). WIRE IT once TR-24 ships its read endpoint: add one more branch after 'Sealed ok?' that calls it with this flow's own periodStart/periodEnd, and on a covering cycle, hub `notify` the HR service tier (a role, not a hardcoded id) with a body naming the cycle -- never inline the auto_inputs values themselves. Env: PLATFORM_URL, PLATFORM_SERVICE_TOKEN, AGENCY_TENANT_ID, HUB_SERVICE_TOKEN, REPORTS_NOTIFY_USER_IDS.
